name: undo-button
title: Undo Button
description: A pill action button that opens a short undo window when pressed. It widens into a past-tense label with an Undo action, a ticking number and a command-key hint while its outline slowly drains, then commits.
use: A destructive or hard-to-reverse action needs a short take-back window without opening a full dialog.
avoid: Undo lasts only a few seconds and the wide pending pill needs row space; not a substitute for real confirmation.
a11y: Button, shortcut, focus ring and phase labels are all present, but the global Cmd/Ctrl+Z listener can clash with a page's own undo. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: respected)
looks: A small rounded pill with a thin outline, a leading line icon and a label, sitting in a row beside a second matching pill. In the pending state it stretches to fit a grey past-tense word, a divider, an Undo arrow, a large countdown digit and a small key hint.
behaves: Pressing swaps the label to past tense and starts a countdown as the border empties clockwise from the top. Hovering pauses the clock, pressing again or the shortcut cancels, and when time runs out a tick replaces the label.
customise: Props set the verb and past-tense label, the leading icon, the undo window, how long the done state lingers and three callbacks; colours and outline styling need a source edit.
weight: light: One small button with a resize observer and a countdown frame loop that runs only while pending.
demo: A message from Priya Raman about moving a Q3 roadmap review, with Archive and Delete buttons beneath.
issues: The pending pill is wide and can push the neighbouring button off a narrow row.
polishWhy: Clean state change and a clever draining outline; the idle pill itself is ordinary.
